# Interface renames must update the bridge and implementation together

Entry 1496 coordinates IEWSMessageCreateCallbacks/IEWSMessageFetchCallbacks to IEws names and renames the folder delete interface to IEwsFolderDeleteCallbacks across IDL, C++ support declarations and Rust imports/macros. Current shared interfaces use IExchange role names and Listener suffixes. Proposed rule for this protocol family: follow the current interface vocabulary across generated and hand-written boundaries; do not treat the older acronym spelling or Callbacks suffix as a universal rule. Static source and test-code inspection only. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime or live accessibility result is claimed.

Scope: Exchange interface naming.
